fields.description: The box vmagent runs on. It scrapes every Inference Server, Gateway Server and Pod that names this agent.
fields.label: Machine

fields.description: Where this agent lives, from its Machine. Picks the ingestion endpoint: its Region's Remote Write URL, if that Region has one.
fields.label: Region

fields.description: Where this agent pushes, resolved when it is installed: its Region's own endpoint, else the fleet-wide one in Grove Settings.
fields.label: Remote Write URL

fields.description: Bearer token this agent pushes with, minted by the ingestion service — it carries the tenant and source. Per agent, since a regional endpoint issues its own. Use Rotate Token to change it: the new one has to reach the box, or the pushes start failing.
fields.label: Metrics Token

fields.description: vLLM engines and pods — kept tight because saturation is read off it.
fields.label: Engine Scrape Interval

fields.description: On-disk queue while the remote is unreachable. Holds the whole fleet this agent scrapes, not one box.
fields.label: Buffer Size
